* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor OpsSpd Lewis LS 1999 Worlds.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Steven played this deck in Game 1 of the Final Confrontation against Gary Carman. The result was a loss by 22 cards after a superbly fought game where Gary pulled a 'masterful move' to avoid a beatdown and went on to win with his ISB deck.
